hook.note: Every word of that verse is our Father speaking, so on the page you are holding it is blue from end to end — and it is Him saying it, about the exact season this edition was set for. That is the difference the color makes, and it is the reason the type being readable matters. The verse is in Volume 2; the set puts the whole Bible in your hands at this size, Genesis through Revelation, nothing abridged.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.

Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Across the whole Bible our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies.

This is the complete three-volume Large Print edition: the whole Bible, Genesis through Revelation — 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses across 2,956 pages, nothing abridged. Wheat, Sage and Mist Blue — one cover colour per volume. Across the three our Father speaks 128,579 words in 5,615 verses, every one set apart in BLUE. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

Set in 14-point type in a single column across the page, so every line reads whole and poetry keeps its shape. Most Bibles labelled large print are 10 to 12 point, and the ones that go bigger force the whole Bible into a single volume on thin paper — ghosting the text through from the other side, and too heavy to hold open. Three volumes on opaque 50lb white paper answer both. And the large print does more than enlarge the words: Divine Voice Color shows you who is speaking, so it serves your ear as well as your eye. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes across the three volumes serve the reader, not the scholar. The full opening pages — Abba Father, a message from Kevin and Shelly, Receiving Your Father, the Preface and About this Translation — are in every volume. A presentation page carries their name.
He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

body: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) Large Print, the complete three-volume set: the whole Bible, Genesis through Revelation. A color coded Bible set in 14-point type in a single column for comfortable reading — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.
Across the three volumes our Father speaks 128,579 words across 5,615 verses, every one set apart in BLUE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Across the whole Bible our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.
God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6).

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.a: Yes — all 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses, nothing abridged. That is what the three volumes are for: at true 14 point in a single column, the complete text will not fit one binding, so it is bound as Volume 1, Genesis–Esther, Volume 2, Job–Malachi and Volume 3, the New Testament. Every verse is there, in full.

faq.q: Do I have to buy all three volumes?
faq.a: No. Each volume stands on its own and each carries the full opening pages, so a single volume is a complete book to read rather than a fragment. The set is for the reader who wants the whole Bible at this type size, and it is priced below the three volumes bought separately.

faq.q: How large is the print, really?
faq.a: True 14 point, set in a single column across the page. Most Bibles sold as large print are 10 to 12 point in two narrow columns — the type here is bigger and the line is wider. Rather than take our word for it, open Look inside above: the sample pages are rendered from the actual print file, so what you see is the type you will hold. Each volume has its own sample.

Both are offered, 6 x 9, in the three cover colors — Wheat, Sage and Mist Blue. Paperback if the volumes are going to be carried and marked; hardback if they are a gift or going on a shelf for years. The interiors are identical, full color throughout. The hardback set is the usual choice for a gift.

faq.q: Is it the same translation as the regular edition?
faq.a: Word for word, yes. The same fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek, the same 170 translation rules, and the same Divine Voice Color throughout. The regular 6 x 9 edition is the same complete Bible in one volume at standard type size. Choose large print for readability; choose the single volume if you want the whole Bible in one book.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a parent or grandparent?
faq.a: It is the most common reason people buy it. There is a presentation page inside the front of every volume for a name and a date, and the hardback is built for years of daily handling. Each volume has its own cover color — Wheat, Sage and Mist Blue — so the set reads as one shelf.
